nameOrigin: to bind with strips of cloth

pokedexEntries.bk: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

pokedexEntries.wh: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

pokedexEntries.sc: Sewaddle chews on leaves to make its clothing. It's trying to mimic the leafy garment Leavanny first dressed it in.

pokedexEntries.vi: The bumps on their heads are sensory organs. When Sewaddle meet, they greet each other by rubbing these bumps together.
